outcome: serum tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFa) levels
cohort: The study participants were preterm Sprague-Dawley pups delivered prematurely from timed-pregnant dams.
finding: eNAMPT neutralization with the ALT-100 monoclonal antibody significantly reduced fecal blood, histologic ileal damage, and inflammatory markers in a preterm pup model of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC).
